title: India's Trade Deficit Hit a 12-Month High — Here's Why #Shorts
description:
India's exports surged 45%. The trade gap still hit a 12-month high.

Imports hit an all-time record of $89.35 billion in October — oil, gold, and factory expansion all played a role. The deficit: $39.88 billion, the highest in 12 months.

What it means for the rupee and your money 👇
